name: brave-api-inspector
description: Brave/Chrome 擴充功能：自動擷取 fetch/XHR 請求參數與回應，支援浮動、側欄、懸浮拖曳

scripts.lint: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check injected.js && node --check popup.js && node --check fullpage.js && node --check floating-panel.js && python3 -m json.tool manifest.json > /dev/null && echo "lint ok"
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/*.zip && zip -r dist/brave-api-inspector.zip . -x "*.git*" "*.DS_Store" "dist/*" "*.zip" "node_modules/*" "assets/screenshots/*" "*.pem" && ls -lh dist/
scripts.build:release: mkdir -p dist && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && zip -r dist/brave-api-inspector-v${VERSION}.zip . -x "*.git*" "*.DS_Store" "dist/*" "*.zip" "node_modules/*" "assets/screenshots/*" && ls -lh dist/
